name: nebula-dust-engine
description: Procedural nebula dust and particle groups for three.js: seeded, editable, pickable and touchable clouds of up to 4 million GPU samples with LOD and light conservation.

scripts.check: node --check ./src/index.js && node --check ./src/gpu-profile.js && node --check ./src/presets.js && node --check ./src/system.js && node --check ./src/examples.js && node --check ./src/all.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node ./test/engine.mjs && node ./test/gpu-profile.mjs && node ./test/phenomena.mjs && node ./test/no-radial-combs.mjs && node ./test/light-conservation.mjs && node --expose-gc ./test/system.mjs && node ./test/glsl-versions.mjs

author: Gustavo Martos Ferri
